asinList.description: ASIN, multiple ASINs separated by English commas, up to 40; format: `^[A-Z0-9]+(,[A-Z0-9]+){0,39}$`

dataSnapshotMonth.description: `nearly` represents the last 30 days of real-time data; historical snapshots can also be queried in the `yyyyMM` format, such as `202412`

keyword.description: Search keywords, it is recommended to use the target site language

matchType.description: Matching method: `1` phrase matching, `2` fuzzy matching, `3` precise matching

nodeLabel.description: Amazon category name, supports multi-level category names, and the levels are separated by English colon `:`

order.description: Sorting configuration, fields are shown in the table below

desc.description: Sorting direction: `true` descending order, `false` ascending order

showVariation.description: Whether to query the variant: `Y` yes, `N` no

size.description: Number of items per page, return 10–100 pieces of data
